NOTE - (1) Pro forma adjustments made in arriving at the estimated 1995 pro forma data reflect Schweitzer-Mauduit's consolidated financial position and results of operations under certain assumptions, including the transactions contemplated in the spin-off and additional administrative and interest costs associated with operating as a separate, independent company, as if they had occurred as of the beginning of 1995.

(3) A French income tax rate increase from 33.33 percent to 36.67 percent was enacted in July 1995, retroactive to January 1, 1995. A one-time favorable impact on the deferred provision for income taxes of $4.5 million ($0.28 per share) was recorded in the third quarter 1995. Also recorded in the third quarter 1995 were the unfavorable impacts of the higher income tax rate on the current provision for income taxes of $0.6 million for a retroactive adjustment of the six-month period ended June 30, 1995 and an additional $0.4 million unfavorable effect on the three-month period ended September 30, 1995.

(4) The average number of common shares outstanding for the three and nine months ended September 30, 1996 was 16.052 million. The pro forma average number of common shares outstanding for the three and nine months ended September 30, 1995 was 16.051 million.
